changelog:
QuickView pre-release v6.37.0.0

- feat(crop): add interactive crop mode — press X or Ctrl+Left-drag a selection to start
- feat(export): add ExportPanel with Save As (Ctrl+S), quality slider (mouse wheel), and live size estimation
- feat(export): discover system WIC encoders dynamically (JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC/AVIF/JXL as available on the machine)
- feat(webview2): experimental DirectComposition host for complex/animated SVGs, with the potential to open any browser-supported format
- feat: add GDI WMF/EMF decode and ship v6.37.0.0
- feat(animated SVG) :Play SMIL/CSS-animated SVG via existing WebView2 host (#242)
- feat(settings): add ShowOSD toggle, Show in Explorer hotkey, and dynamic menu hotkey rendering (https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/144)
- feat(gallery): add Gallery Minimum Size slider and keep the current session when opening a folder (https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/242)
- fix(gallery):fix gallery session, expand/shrink, and min-size setting (#242)
- fix(crop): smart window expansion, DComp surface re-bake on apply, and crop dimensions in the info panel
- fix(export): preserve embedded ICC profiles and reset quality/lossless when switching formats
- fix(webview2): resolve DComp zoom/offset drift, double-scale, blur/clip, UI-thread deadlock, and SVG flash (https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/238, https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/242)
- fix(settings): restore slider hit-testing, 1px WindowMinSize steps, and button/dropdown click detection (https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/242)
- fix(ui): info-panel exit redraw, overlay mouse passthrough, and crop-mode tooltip (https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/issues/144)
- fix(exif): decouple physical metadata from view state and unify single-pass transform pipelines
- fix(ci): vendor arch-specific WebView2LoaderStatic.lib for ARM64
- perf: shrink binary via packed structs, template erasure, and cached dialog layout
- chore(submodule): update unrar-mini

Full Changelog: https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/compare/v6.29.0.0...v6.37.0.0
